parameters.name: raw_material_count
parameters.description: Number of raw materials in the finite set $\mathcal{R}$

parameters.name: product_count
parameters.description: Number of final products in the finite set $\mathcal{P}$

parameters.name: sulfur_content
parameters.description: Sulfur content of each raw material $r \in \mathcal{R}$

parameters.name: purchase_cost
parameters.description: Purchase cost of each raw material $r \in \mathcal{R}$

parameters.name: supply_limit
parameters.description: Available supply limit of each raw material $r \in \mathcal{R}$; infinity may denote unlimited supply

parameters.name: sulfur_cap
parameters.description: Maximum allowed sulfur content for each product $p \in \mathcal{P}$

parameters.name: demand_limit
parameters.description: Market demand limit for each product $p \in \mathcal{P}$

variables.name: first_stage_allocation
variables.description: First-stage allocation quantity from raw material $r \in \mathcal{R}^{(1)}$ to product $p \in \mathcal{P}$

variables.name: second_stage_allocation
variables.description: Second-stage allocation quantity of designated raw material $r^{(2)}$ for each product $p \in \mathcal{P}$

constraints.name: nonnegative_first_stage_allocation
constraints.description: First-stage allocation quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: nonnegative_second_stage_allocation
constraints.description: Second-stage allocation quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: supply_limit_bound
constraints.description: Raw material usage must not exceed available supply limits

constraints.name: demand_limit_bound
constraints.description: Production quantities must not exceed market demand limits

constraints.name: sulfur_cap_bound
constraints.description: Linear sulfur-content limit: weighted sulfur input to each product cannot exceed the product sulfur cap times production quantity

constraints.name: two_stage_mixing_sequence
constraints.description: Only raw materials in the first-stage set may be allocated in stage one; all other raw-material/product allocations are fixed to zero

constraints.name: production_consistency
constraints.description: Production quantity equals total blended input for each product across both stages

constraints.name: nonnegative_data_domain
constraints.description: Supply limits, demand limits, and sulfur caps are nonnegative, and the planning data are finite with the designated subset and second-stage material properly defined

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit, defined as total sales revenue minus total raw-material purchasing cost

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit, defined as total sales revenue minus total raw-material purchasing cost, with \Pi recorded as the resulting profit expression
final_objective.formula: \Pi = \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} v_p q_p - \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}^{(1)}} c_r \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} x^{(1)}_{r,p} - c_{r^{(2)}} \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} x^{(2)}_{p}
